header: THE LIST OF TOPICS (logic side). One line for each subject the search bar knows. To add a topic: a folder in src/tools/<topic>/ (see types.ts) + one line here + one line in registry.ui.tsx. The ORDER here is the order of the user guide's sample questions and of the tiles in the list of calculators (registry.ui.tsx follows it); the order in which a typed line is tried is set by each topic's `rank`, not by this list. Nothing outside this folder names a topic: detect.ts, ToolPanel.tsx and sampleQuestions.ts only walk this list.

doc: This covers every kind of typed line that a topic answers, together with what its card needs.

behaviours: the two registries list the same topics in the same order
every topic has a folder with its two descriptors, topic.ts (what the search line needs) and ui.tsx (how it looks)
every folder of src/tools is a listed topic (no folder is left out of the registry)
every topic with logic of its own has its own selftest in its folder (a new topic cannot be added untested)
every form is drawn: a title, a tone, an icon and a tile in the list of calculators
a topic has a form in one registry exactly when it has one in the other
every live topic has its card, every card its words
form ranks are unique (the order in which plain-word requests are tried is never a tie)
every form has nouns, and a request that is only its nouns and fillers can be told from a sentence
every sample question is answered by the topic that lists it: instant ones as you type, the others by opening its form
the list of calculators answers its own sample
the page of all the utility services answers its own sample, and the two lists never answer for each other
every kind of answer a topic gives has a card (every sample that is answered as you type can be drawn)
detect.ts, ToolPanel.tsx and sampleQuestions.ts import only the registries and the contract (plus the one rate-table hook): they name no topic
the shared files do not mention a topic by its words either (no 'tyre', 'vin', 'gratuity'... in detect.ts or ToolPanel.tsx outside comments)
a topic imports only its own folder, the shared libraries and the contract, apart from the declared tyre/rim dependency
every file that draws markup with Tailwind classes is inside a folder that tailwind.config.js scans
every topic has an intent (a title, a sentence about it, and at least four words people use for it)
